items.question: Does a vendor need a valid trade licence to participate in engineering project tenders run by the UAE Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure?
items.gold: Yes, vendors must register with the ministry and have a valid trade licence to participate in tenders.
items.fact: Tender participation requires valid trade licence and prior ministry registration.

items.question: What does the UAE Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure publish online to ensure fair competition among suppliers in its tenders?
items.gold: All its upcoming projects that will receive tenders and award contracts.
items.fact: Ministry publishes all upcoming projects online to ensure fair competition.
